steps.title: Conga line south
steps.rule: Line up 11m south of the middle, west to east: H1, caster, D1, MT, OT, D2, ranged, H2. The line order decides who takes which home spot once the debuffs come.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 11m south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 13m south-east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 13m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: Go to your home on the wall
steps.rule: Leave the line for your home on the wall. Spreads, in line order from the west: west, north-north-west, north-north-east, east. Stack and unmarked pair up: the first pair south-south-west, the second pair south-south-east, unmarked just inside the stack.

steps.title: Hug the edge of the first hand
steps.cue: The first Wave Repeater ring goes off
steps.rule: Slide along the wall away from the nearest hand until you are clear of its cleave, about 38 degrees off the hand.

steps.title: Duck under the outer ring
steps.cue: The next Wave Repeater ring is coming
steps.rule: Step in to about 15m so the outer repeater ring passes over you, staying on the same bearing.

RegenHealer.rule: If you are in Spreads: Stand near waymark D, the west wall; otherwise: Stand near waymark 3, the south-west wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: If you are in Spreads: Stand near waymark B, the east wall; otherwise: Stand near waymark 2, the south-east wall.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in Spreads: Stand near waymark D, the west wall; otherwise: Go to the south wall.

steps.title: Back to the wall
steps.rule: Step straight back out to the wall on the same bearing to dodge the inner rings.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on FirstHands and Spreads has RegenHealer: South & no → SW wall; North & no → S wall; North & yes → W wall; South & yes → W wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on FirstHands and Spreads has ShieldHealer: South & no → SE wall; North & yes → E wall; South & yes → E wall; North & no → S wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on FirstHands and Spreads has CasterDps: South & yes → W wall; North & yes → W wall; North & no → S wall; South & no → SW wall.

steps.title: Tuck into the hand that already hit
steps.cue: Colossal Blow from the first hands resolves
steps.rule: Move toward the hand that just went off and tuck in about 14 degrees inside it, 16m out; that side is now safe from the second set of hands.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on FirstHands and Spreads has RegenHealer: South & no → S wall; North & no → near 3 (SW wall); North & yes → W wall; South & yes → W wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on FirstHands and Spreads has ShieldHealer: South & no → S wall; North & yes → E wall; South & yes → E wall; North & no → near 2 (SE wall).

steps.title: Clock spots for Hello World
steps.cue: Colossal Blow and the snipes resolve
steps.rule: Walk in to 10m and around to your Hello World clock spot: MT north, R1 north-east, H2 east, D2 south-east, OT south, D1 south-west, H1 west, D3 north-west.

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 10m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 10m north-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 10m north-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 10m east of the centre.
